description: An upright, broadly rounded squash divided into three bulging vertical lobes. A short curved stem rises from the top, and the central lobe narrows to a gently pointed base.
A tilted seasoning shaker hovers above the right side of a wide, round-bottomed bowl on a short foot. Two diagonal falling marks connect the shaker to the open bowl.
An apple with a curved stem rests on the left platform of a kitchen scale. A tall post supports a round dial with an angled needle above the long shared base.
Four separate outlines form a two-by-two assortment: a five-pointed star, a circle, a four-lobed flower, and a heart. The rounded shapes are evenly spaced and have empty interiors.
A vertically cut avocado half has a narrow rounded top and a broad curved base. One large oval pit sits below the center within the otherwise empty pear-shaped flesh.
A squat flour bag has gently flared sides, rounded lower corners, and a broad folded band closing the top. A small rounded mound of flour appears on the front.
A shallow baking tray projects forward from an open oven, holding four round cookies in two rows. Two curling heat lines rise above the tray between the oven’s upper edges.
A broad slotted spatula and a two-pronged fork stand upright side by side. Each has a thin shaft leading into a long rounded handle, forming a matching barbecue utensil pair.
A broad, heart-shaped root narrows to a point with three fine rootlets. Three long pointed leaves fan upward from its rounded shoulders, with the tallest leaf in the middle.
A rounded beet bulb tapers into a long pointed root. A slender central stalk rises from its flattened top and branches into two broad leaves that spread left and right.
A rounded rectangular bento box is divided into one wide lower compartment and two smaller upper compartments, one holding a round food piece. Two long chopsticks stand beside its right edge.
An upright oval bento box has two upper compartments and a larger lower section containing a softly scalloped mound of food. Two slightly splayed chopsticks stand to the right.
An upright ice cream bar has rounded lower corners and a large curved bite missing from its upper-right edge. A narrow rounded wooden stick extends centrally below the bar.
Three rounded bok choy leaves flare outward above a thick joined base. The tallest central leaf carries a straight midrib and two diagonal branches, while the outer leaves curve inward below.
Two large cookies overlap above the straight rim of a deep, footed bowl. The front cookie has a scalloped bite missing from its upper-right edge; the rear cookie remains round.
A wide semicircular bowl stands on a short rectangular foot. Three nested noodle arches rise above the straight rim, with the largest arch spanning most of the bowl’s width.
Two long chopsticks angle gently upward to the right above a footed bowl. Three wavy noodle strands hang from the lower stick into the open bowl beneath them.
Three overlapping rounded mounds of noodles fill a shallow bowl with a flat bottom and curved sides. Nested arcs inside the mounds show the looping pasta above the straight rim.
A deep round-bottomed bowl is seen from slightly above, with its oval opening visible. Two long chopsticks rise diagonally from the bowl, spreading apart toward the upper right.
Several long rectangular fries fan out from an open takeaway carton. The carton has sloping sides, rounded bottom corners, and a scooped front edge that reveals the lower fries.
An upright cereal carton is shown with its narrow left side and folded top visible. A large circular front label contains two short curved marks suggesting the packaged cereal.
Three long curved bananas fan downward and left from a shared thick stem at the upper right. Their overlapping crescent shapes end in blunt tips at different heights.
A compact bunch of overlapping round grapes narrows to one berry at the bottom. A slender curved stem rises above the central grape between the upper pair.
Four round currant berries hang individually from curved offshoots of a slender diagonal branch. The berries alternate on either side, with two larger hanging berries near the bottom.
A smooth butternut squash leans from lower left to upper right, widening into a bulbous base. Its narrower neck ends in a rounded shoulder and a short curling stem.
A cake wedge has a rectangular lower layer and a curved upper surface that slopes down toward the right. A round cherry with a curling stem sits on top.
A cylindrical food can is viewed slightly from above, showing an oval top and curved bottom edge. A small blank rectangular label follows the curve of its front.
A bunch of celery lies diagonally from lower left to upper right. Long parallel stalks form a rounded base and meet a broad cluster of softly scalloped leaves.
A tall chef’s hat has a three-lobed crown, a straight lower band, and three vertical pleats. A separate curled mustache centered beneath it suggests a chef’s face.

description: A low serving bowl holds a rounded mound of rice with a chicken drumstick laid diagonally across its upper-left side. A second oval food piece rises behind the mound.
A chicken drumstick points diagonally upward to the right. Its broad oval meat portion narrows toward a short exposed bone ending in two rounded lobes at the lower left.
A round apricot half is viewed straight onto its cut face. A large pointed oval stone occupies the center, surrounded by a broad uninterrupted ring of fruit flesh.
A hamburger has a broad domed top bun above a wavy band of filling. A shallow lower bun curves upward at both ends beneath the separated layers.
A stylized cloudberry has three rounded upper lobes around a pointed central segment. Two long curved leaves spread sideways beneath the fruit, meeting at a short descending stem.
A berry cluster has one round central segment surrounded by four round lobes. Two pointed leaves spread above it beside a slender curved stem, giving a flower-like silhouette.
A snowflake spreads six long arms from a central junction. Each arm carries a pair of short angled branches, with the vertical arm extending above and below the center.
A snowflake-like mark has long radiating arms with forked ends around a central junction. Its lower branches spread unevenly, and a short straight stem drops from the center.
A corndog lies diagonally from upper left to lower right, with a long oval coating and a rounded wooden stick. A loose zigzag of mustard runs along its center.
A front-facing crab has a broad body that tapers to a rounded lower point. Two large open pincers arch above it, and three curved legs extend from each side.
A three-tined fork and a broad chef’s knife cross diagonally into an X. The fork head sits at upper left, while the pointed curved blade occupies the upper right.
A fork and spoon cross at their long straight handles, forming an X. The fork’s rounded pronged head sits at upper left and the spoon’s oval bowl at upper right.
Two long biscuit sticks with rounded tops lean apart inside a tapered cup. The cup’s straight upper rim hides their lower ends, and its narrow base has rounded corners.
A cupcake has a tapered wrapper divided by a central vertical line and a broad scalloped frosting cap. A round cherry with a curved stem rests on the crown.
A shrimp curls into a thick C shape with a rounded head at upper left and a small forked tail below. Curved dividing lines mark its shell segments.
A kitchen knife angles upward to the right, with a broad blade whose tip and cutting edge are smoothly rounded. A long rounded handle joins the narrower lower-left end.
A kitchen knife points diagonally upward to the right. Its blade has a straight spine and curved cutting edge meeting at a sharp tip, above a long rounded handle.
A slender herb stem curves slightly to the right as it rises. Short curved branchlets alternate along both sides, creating a sparse airy sprig with open spaces between its offshoots.
A dining knife and a two-pronged fork stand upright side by side. The knife has a curved tapered blade on the left; both utensils have long straight narrow handles.
An upright ear of corn has a tall rounded cob framed by two pointed husk leaves. The leaves curve outward at their tips and overlap near the narrow base.
A tall pointed egg stands upright in a low oval egg cup, viewed slightly from above. The cup’s curved front rim overlaps the egg’s base, with bold outlines throughout.
Three upright eggs sit side by side above a shallow carton’s broad top rim. Three rounded pockets hang beneath the rim, separated by deep notches matching the eggs’ positions.
